---
applyTo: "**/*.py"
---

Follow the repository root `AGENTS.md`. Preserve established code style and comments in touched files. Make the smallest necessary change. Do not mass-format or refactor unrelated Python files. For changes to B# semantics, inspect the existing parser, AST, runtime, interpreter, type system, and characterization tests relevant to the behavior before editing. Do not add dependencies or change public behavior without explicit authorization.
